sources.title: Gates — Preventing Water Pump Installation Problems
sources.scope: Generic Gates technical explanation, not a44009 drawing
sources.summary: The stationary sealing assembly is fixed to the housing but can move axially under spring pressure. The mating assembly rotates with the shaft. Spring and coolant pressure maintain face contact, with a thin coolant film controlling friction and heat. These are separate from the bearing grease seals.
sources.capture: Reviewed through web tool; direct HTML download returned403. Summary preserved here; original HTML not claimed.

sources.title: Schaeffler TPI131 — Water pump bearings
sources.scope: Generic manufacturer bearing architecture; no relationship to Gates44009 established
sources.summary: Shaft raceways replace a separate inner ring. The unit combines rolling-element rows, cages, a common outer ring and end seals. Ball/ball, roller/ball and triple-row designs are offered. The application-specific choice cannot be determined from the exterior pump photograph. Published standard sizes do not justify selecting an installed bearing number.
sources.pages: Printed5–10 for architecture/variants;12–13 for mounting and standard dimensions.

sources.title: GMB Water Pumps — manufacturer cutaways
sources.scope: Generic GMB construction only; not evidence of Gates internal materials or exactparts
sources.summary: Manufacturer cutaways illustrate a spring-loaded mechanical face seal near the impeller and a separate sealed shaft bearing. GMB describes elastomer supports and carbon/ceramic faces for its products; that material claim is not transferred to Gates44009.

decision: Proceed with a clearly illustrative six-component mechanical face-seal study. Preserve bearing cartridge until specific row/race evidence is available; do not inflate verified truck parts with an arbitrarily chosen bearing arrangement.
